effect_source_en: Effect: Weapon upgrades grant one additional stat line (e.g., typical rolls increase from two stats to three; lowest tier from one to two).
overview_source_en: Megabonk’s Items index includes a handful of run-defining pickups—Anvil is one of the most impactful because it improves every future weapon level you take after acquiring it. The extra stat line compounds over time, so the earlier you secure Anvil, the stronger your endgame scaling tends to be. Consistent upgrades benefit from more chances at damage/projectile stats.

effect_source_en: Effect: Lifesteal now triggers Bloodmark stacks and also has a 50% chance to apply Bloodmark on hit.
Effect: 15% chance on hit to summon dragonfire that burns enemies (applies a burn DoT).
Effect: Grants cooldown reduction and enables energy regeneration for smoother, more frequent ability usage.
Effect: +100 Max HP, +50 HP Regen. When you receive healing, it radiates damaging energy to nearby enemies.
Effect: 1% chance to instantly Execute a regular enemy. Each successful execute permanently increases your damage by +1% for the rest of the run.
overview_source_en: Joe’s Dagger is a late-game scaling item that rewards long, enemy-dense stages. If you’re new to items, browse the Items Database first; below we focus on the precise unlock and post-v1.0.12 mechanics.

effect_source_en: Effect: 25% chance on hit to summon lightning that can stun enemies.
Effect (Status): Unconfirmed. Community reports conflict between “increases Gold Gain” and “does nothing.” Until official notes clarify, treat it as experimental.

Effect: Applies 4 stacks of poison to enemies on
                    hit.

Effect: Increases WEAPON level cap only . First pot: +10 levels . Stacking has diminishing
                        returns (-1 per additional pot, minimum +2).
Effect: Killing an enemy summons two homing souls that seek and damage other enemies.
overview_source_en: Each enemy kill spawns two homing souls that fly to other targets. This turns normal clears into chain reactions and is especially strong in high-density maps.

effect_source_en: Effect: When you take damage while under 50% HP , time slows and you deal 2× damage for a short duration.
overview_source_en: All statements above are corroborated by multiple independent guides and community documentation.

effect_source_en: Effect: Periodically drags in XP shards around you, making level-ups more consistent and reducing backtracking.

Effect: When a hit would kill you, freeze time and prevent
          death. One use per run.
overview_source_en:
Note on healing: Some community write-ups mention a full heal on trigger. This is not confirmed by official notes; treat as unknown/unconfirmed and play as if you only gain a time-freeze
          safety window.

effect_source_en: Effect: +1 chance to proc on-hit effects (chance-based effects roll an extra time).
overview_source_en: Pair the Lamp with items that check on-hit chances frequently.

effect_source_en: Effect: 2% chance to BONK an enemy, dealing 20× damage. Unlock: Unlocked by default.
overview_source_en: Every time you land an attack, there is an independent 2% roll to “BONK” that hit for 20× damage. The effect does not require any setup and is available from the start of the game.

effect_source_en: Effect: +20% Lifesteal and allows Overheal up to 75% of Max HP.
overview_source_en: Chonkplate converts any healing you receive while at full HP into an Overheal buffer up to 75% of your Max HP. The built-in +20% Lifesteal feeds that buffer continuously once your damage output ramps up.

effect_source_en: Effect: Converts qualifying critical hits into Megacrits . A Megacrit deals 4x damage by default , increased by +0.15 per additional Giant Fork stack .
overview_source_en:
Giant Fork introduces a roll on your critical hits to upgrade them into Megacrits . Official v1.0.49 notes define the current damage multiplier as 4x by
        default , with +0.15 added for each additional Fork stack .

effect_source_en: Effect: 20% chance to inflict Ice on hit, which can freeze enemies.
overview_source_en: Freeze uptime scales with how many times you hit — multi-hit or rapid-hit weapons can keep packs locked down.

effect_source_en: Effect: 8% chance on hit to create a giant blast, damaging and knocking enemies away.
overview_source_en: Power Gloves adds a small, reliable on-hit blast to any build. Each successful hit has an 8% chance to trigger a circular explosion that damages and knocks back nearby enemies. In v1.0.49, its base damage and blast radius were increased and its minimum cooldown was reduced; the official notes do not publish the new numeric values.

effect_source_en: Effect: Attacks have a 25% chance to explode, dealing 65% Area-of-Effect damage to nearby enemies.
overview_source_en: Every time you land a hit, there’s a 25% chance to trigger a small explosion that deals 65% damage in an area. It’s a straightforward crowd-control effect that scales with how many times you hit enemies per second.

effect_source_en:
Effect: The first copy raises all Tome level caps by +10 .
                    Later copies have diminishing returns, decreasing by one level per copy to a +2 minimum.
overview_source_en:
Wizard's Hat is the Tome equivalent of Pot
                    (Stainless Steel) . While Pot now only affects weapon level caps, Wizard's Hat specifically
                targets Tome (passive book) level caps.

effect_source_en: Megabonk Bob's Light guide: use a lamp for Big Bob's finishing blow, then learn its 45-second pulse, stacking, boss damage and Red Ghost effect.
overview_source_en: The pulse is centered on your character. It does not require a weapon hit and is most valuable once enemy density becomes high enough that ordinary weapons struggle to clear the screen.

effect_source_en: Effect (verified): +10% Difficulty, 0.8× Max HP, and a 5% on-hit chance to cast a curse that damages nearby enemies.
overview_source_en: Browse the full items database or read on for a verified, spoiler-lite breakdown of Cursed Grabbies. This item increases overall difficulty and slightly reduces your Max HP, but grants a small on-hit chance to apply a curse that damages nearby enemies. It’s unlocked by raising the Cursed Tome to Level 10.

effect_source_en: Effect: Gain +0.1% Damage per kill , up to +100% total this run.
Effect: +66% damage vs airborne enemies; 8% chance to launch enemies into the air.
Effect: Increases damage the lower your HP.
overview_source_en:
Gamer Goggles is a damage-scaling item that shines when you’re on the brink: as your health drops, your damage ramps up. 
        If you’re cataloging or comparing items, browse the full Megabonk Item Database for context and counters.

effect_source_en: Effect: Gain Armor and an Overheal buffer for each poisoned enemy nearby (dynamic; not shown on the stat panel). Note: Some guides still list “Lifesteal” — community testing and recent descriptions point to Overheal.
Effect (verified): Critical hits have a 50% chance to explode, dealing 50% damage to nearby enemies.
Effect: XP shards slice through enemies while traveling across the map, dealing damage as they pass.
Effect (verified): 20% chance to fire missiles on kill . Multiple community guides agree; some players reported “on-hit” behavior in recent builds—treated as an exception/bug.
Effect: When you take damage, Toxic Barrel releases a lingering poison cloud that damages and poisons nearby enemies.
overview_source_en: Toxic Barrel converts your moments of vulnerability into offense: every time you take damage , it emits a toxic cloud that lingers and applies poison. This naturally complements close-range brawling, kiting choke points, and any setup that keeps enemies around you.

effect_source_en: Effect: Move Speed converts to Attack Speed ( max +40% per stack ).
overview_source_en: Turbo Skates turns flat Movement Speed into Attack Speed , letting speed-focused builds reach new DPS ceilings. The conversion is capped at +40% Attack Speed per stack , so multiple copies scale cleanly without breaking the cap per stack.

effect_source_en:
Effect: 25% chance to punch yourself when you hit enemies (cannot kill you).
                    Triggers on-hit effects.
overview_source_en:
Kevin is one of the most unique items in Megabonk. Instead of directly buffing your character, it creates
                a controlled self-damage loop that can be weaponized with the right build.

effect_source_en: Megabonk Pumpkin guide: break every pumpkin on Graveyard as Roberto, use the counter, and learn its +8 future pots and +18% reward effect.
Effect: +1 Projectile Count for all weapons .
overview_source_en: Backpack is a straightforward power spike: it adds one extra projectile to every weapon you fire. If you are new to Megabonk, start here—this page compiles verified facts and safe tips. Early on, you can also browse the full Items index for more unlocks. Backpack shines on weapons that scale with projectile count. Popular picks include:

effect_source_en: Effect: Charging a Charge Shrine creates a healing zone and +2 extra Charge Shrines will appear on future stages.
overview_source_en: Beacon is a shrine-centric utility item. Each time you charge a Charge Shrine, it drops a healing field. In addition, upcoming stages will spawn two extra Charge Shrines, increasing the number of opportunities to gain shrine rewards.

effect_source_en: Effect: Gain a brief speed boost when you are hit, plus a permanent +5% Move Speed .
Effect: Critical hits have a 25% chance to heal you.

Effect (verified): Gain Max HP on enemy kills, stacking up to a cap (community-verified model: +0.5 Max HP per kill, up to 200 stacks). Unlock: Raise your Max HP with Blood Magic a total of 400 times (account-wide).
overview_source_en: Demonic Blood is a scaling health item that rewards aggressive play. Each kill adds to your Max HP until you hit the item’s cap, making it a cornerstone for high-HP “tank” archetypes and any build that converts health into damage. If you’re new to items, browse the full Items database index first.

effect_source_en: Effect: +12% chance to spawn a bonus XP shard on kill .
Effect: Gain +15% Gold from killing enemies . Unlocked by default.
overview_source_en: Golden Glove adds a flat +15% multiplier to gold gained from enemy kills . It does not change combat power directly, but it increases your buying power during the run, enabling more shop purchases, rerolls, and shrine interactions.

effect_source_en:
Effect: Gain gold when you take damage. (Effect text verified;
            numeric values not officially published.)
overview_source_en:
Golden Shield converts each instance of you being hit into gold. This makes it an economy tool that
        rewards controlled chip damage, rather than pure avoidance. Because the exact gold value per hit is not
        disclosed by official notes or media, treat it as a qualitative bonus and build accordingly.

effect_source_en:
Effect: Earn 0.1 gold per meter as you move around the map. Buffed
            from 0.05 in v1.0.49. Unlock: Break 150 pots.
overview_source_en:
Golden Sneakers turns movement into income at the current rate of 0.1 gold per meter traveled , doubled from 0.05 in v1.0.49. This makes it ideal for route-based
        farming and for builds that naturally traverse large
        parts of the map.

effect_source_en: Effect: Grants a flat +10% Damage (verified). Unlock: Available by default (in the item pool).
overview_source_en:
Gym Sauce is a simple but reliable damage booster for any run. It adds a flat +10% Damage and is available from the start,
        so it often appears early and helps you stabilize your build. If you are browsing more items, see the complete items index .

effect_source_en: Effect: While standing still, your damage ramps up and caps at +100% . Best for grounded, hold-position playstyles.
Effect: Thorns damage has a 50% chance to explode.
Effect: Increase Max HP by 50% but reduce HP Regen by 50% . Unlocks in your item pool after Regen Tome reaches Level 8 .
Effect: Reflect incoming damage to attackers and grant a brief window of invulnerability when you’re hit.
overview_source_en:
Mirror is a defensive item that turns enemy aggression against them: when you’re hit, you reflect the incoming damage and gain a brief invulnerability window (“I-frames”). This helps you push through dense waves or survive sudden bursts. 
        If you’re new to items, check the full Items database for context and comparisons.

effect_source_en: Effect: Creates a lingering poison cloud whenever you hit enemies (on-hit area damage over time).
Effect: After evading, your next hit deals 2× Damage and you gain brief Attack Speed and Move Speed boosts.
Effect: +15% Evasion chance to completely avoid incoming damage.
overview_source_en: Slippery Ring is a default item that provides a simple yet effective defensive layer: +15% to your internal Evasion stat . When you evade an attack, you take no damage at all and the game does not register you as being "hit."

effect_source_en: Effect: Casts blood magic when you hit an enemy, dealing AoE damage and healing you for 7.5% . Cooldown: 9s . Unlocked by default.
Effect: Gain +2 Thorns per 1% Armor and +10% Armor . Unlocked by default.
overview_source_en: Spiky Shield is a retaliation staple: it both raises your Armor and converts that Armor into Thorns damage. As your Armor scales, the reflected damage scales alongside it, letting melee swarms delete themselves on contact.

effect_source_en: Effect: On hit, generate a lightning strike (10s cooldown) .
overview_source_en: Thunder Mitts adds a passive lightning strike whenever your attacks hit an enemy. The effect has a global 10s cooldown and is available from the start of the game once you begin a run.

effect_source_en: Effect: +8% XP Gain. Accelerates leveling speed for faster power spikes and more upgrade opportunities.
overview_source_en: Time Bracelet is one of the simplest yet most powerful items in Megabonk. It provides a flat percentage increase to all XP gained, allowing you to level up faster throughout your entire run. Since leveling is the primary way to access weapon upgrades, tome improvements, and build-defining choices, faster XP gain directly translates to stronger builds and better survival odds.

effect_source_en: Effect: 35% chance to apply Bloodmark on hit (stacks). Browse all items to see more on-hit effects.
Effect: Shrines charge 4% faster and give +7.5% Shrine rewards.
overview_source_en: Wrench is a tempo and economy tool for Shrine-focused routes. Its two effects are straightforward and reliable:

effect_source_en: Megabonk Old Mask guide: find it on Graveyard, understand its +15% Elite Spawn Increase stacking, and decide when the extra elites are worth it.
Effect: Grants +8% Attack Speed . Unlock: Reach Cooldown Tome Lv. 5 .
overview_source_en: Battery is a straightforward tempo booster: increasing Attack Speed by 8% helps more hits land in the same window, which benefits sustained-fire weapons and “on-hit” effects. Attack Speed doesn’t alter raw damage per hit; it raises your damage throughput by letting your weapons act more frequently.

effect_source_en:
Effect: Deal +20% damage per 100 Max HP . Scales directly with your maximum
          health.
overview_source_en:
For every 100 points of Max HP you have, your damage increases by +20% . Example: at 500 Max
        HP, your total damage bonus from Beefy Ring is +100%. This bonus is multiplicative with the ring’s own scaling
        and updates as your Max HP changes (e.g., via items or level-up HP gains).

effect_source_en: Effect: +20% Damage at the cost of -5% Max HP .
Effect: For every 14 units moved , summon Bob (dead) — a ghost that damages nearby enemies.
Effect: +2% chance to spawn a healing Borgar when you kill an enemy. The pickup restores health on grab (amount may vary by version).
overview_source_en: Borgar rolls a 2% chance to drop a healing pickup each time you defeat an enemy. Because it triggers on kill , higher kill counts naturally lead to more opportunities for healing.

effect_source_en: Effect: Deal +15% damage to Elites and Bosses .
Effect: Deal +20% damage to nearby enemies.
Effect: Shoots spikes when you take damage. Damage scales with Thorns . Unlock: Kill 100 cactus enemies with Thorns damage.
overview_source_en: Cactus turns taking damage into offense: whenever you’re hit, it emits spikes whose damage scales with your current Thorns value. This naturally rewards close-range, defensive play.

effect_source_en: Effect: Heals you while standing still . Move to stop the effect. Browse all items →
overview_source_en: Campfire provides passive healing only while you are stationary . It’s most useful during short lulls or when you can safely hold position.

effect_source_en:
Effect: Permanently increases Luck by 10% (buffed from 7.5% in
                    v1.0.49). Improves item drop rarity, upgrade quality, and Shrine rewards.
overview_source_en:
Clover is one of the most universally valuable items in Megabonk. As a default starting item , it requires no unlock and can
                appear in your very first run. Its simple yet powerful effect— +10% Luck (buffed from
                7.5% in v1.0.49)—quietly shapes the quality of everything you acquire throughout your run.

effect_source_en:
Effect: Gain +2% Luck each time you open a chest (applies for the
                    current run). ⚠️ Each card also increases chest prices by +10% (added
                        in v1.0.49).
overview_source_en:
Credit Card (Green) is a Rare passive Item . Every chest you open adds +2%
                    Luck for the rest of that run. This applies to regular, free, and golden chests.

effect_source_en: Effect: Adds +2.5% Damage when you open a chest. Stacks each time you open one (community-verified) .
overview_source_en: Credit Card (Red) grants a flat +2.5% Damage when you open a chest. The bonus stacks per chest opened during the run ( community-verified from player testing ).

effect_source_en: Effect (current): Curses up to 5 enemies , dealing 30% of each target’s Max HP per second (ticks every 1s). Changed in v1.0.17 from 1 → 5 targets.
overview_source_en: Cursed Doll applies a damage-over-time effect that removes a fixed percentage of Max HP from affected enemies each second. As of v1.0.17 (Oct 19, 2025) , each 1-second tick can curse up to five enemies simultaneously. If you are planning around “%HP” damage, remember that it scales with enemy Max HP and is therefore valuable against high-HP targets. Interaction with bosses is currently unconfirmed due to conflicting community reports.

effect_source_en: Effect: When you take damage, Electric Plug sends out an electric shock to nearby enemies. (Default unlock)
overview_source_en: Electric Plug is a reactive utility item: whenever you take a hit, it emits a brief electric shock that can hit nearby enemies. There are no officially published numbers for its damage or radius, so treat it as a light crowd-control tool that rewards intentional tanking and proximity play.

effect_source_en: Effect (v1.0.64): Jump higher and farther. +10% forward jump speed and +1 extra jump !
Effect: +10% Critical Chance.
overview_source_en: Forbidden Juice passively raises your Critical Chance by 10% . This simple modifier scales any build that converts crits into extra damage or effects. It is especially valuable on high-crit weapons and characters that can stack crit bonuses reliably.

effect_source_en: Effect: Summons ghosts whenever you use an interactable (e.g., pots, shrines). Great for map control without direct weapon use.
overview_source_en: Ghost creates temporary allies each time you interact with stage objects. Typical triggers include pots and certain shrines . This lets you convert map interaction into extra damage and crowd control even when you’re not attacking directly.

effect_source_en: Effect: Grants a 7.5% chance to freeze enemies on hit and executes enemies that drop below a health threshold. Looking for more items? Browse the full Items database .
Effect: Adds a chance for chests to open for free (base +10%). Stacking is non-linear (not simple +10% per Key). See the Stacking Note below.
overview_source_en:
The Key is a simple but powerful economy item that lets you save gold by occasionally opening chests for free. 
        If you’re new to items, browse the full Items database to understand how economy pieces fit into your build.

effect_source_en: Effect: +45 HP Regen ( ≈0.75 HP/second ).
Effect: 40% chance to poison enemies on hit, dealing damage over time.
overview_source_en: Moldy Cheese is one of the most consistent damage-over-time (DOT) items in Megabonk. Its 40% proc rate makes it reliable for applying poison to large groups of enemies, allowing you to focus on survival while your poison does the work.

effect_source_en: Effect: +25 Max HP per copy. Unlocked by default.
Effect (v1.0.17+): Deal +50% Damage while airborne .
overview_source_en: Scarf grants a flat damage multiplier only while your character is airborne . This was buffed from +33% to +50% on Oct 19, 2025 (v1.0.17) , making aerial windows a sizable DPS spike.

effect_source_en: Effect: Adds +7% Difficulty to your run.
overview_source_en: Skuleg is a pure modifier: when equipped, it increases the run’s Difficulty by 7% . Higher Difficulty means denser waves and tougher enemies, which commonly translates into faster XP and coin gain if you can survive.

effect_source_en: Effect: Deal +20% damage to enemies whose HP is above 90% .
overview_source_en: Tactical Glasses adds a conditional damage bonus that only applies to “healthy” targets. The +20% modifier is checked when the enemy’s current HP is above 90%, rewarding strong openers and precision shots.

effect_source_en: Effect: +15% Movement Speed (enters item pool after you upgrade Agility Tome to Level 5).
overview_source_en:
Megabonk Items Database entry for Turbo Socks — a straightforward, always-on movement boost.
        The +15% speed helps with shrine routing, chest runs, and survivability during dense waves, especially on slower champions.
